sources.title: E64 WS native grinding disk distance and zero calibration

scope.applicability: native displayed disk distance, not particle diameter or validation of recovered algorithms

facts.control: electronic recipe grinding degree operated through display and rotary knob
facts.calibration: manufacturer fine grinding disk distance calibration procedure

notes: Original operating instructions page 13 defines the µm unit and direction; page 26 covers fine disk-distance calibration.
The internal research coordinate is expressed in 0.1 µm: 500 research dD equals 50 µm as a unit conversion. This does not validate firmware behavior, limits or grinder portability.
No universal user setting range or increment is inferred from the manual.
